next_step_summary: PR #231 is an explicitly product-owner-authorized bounded corrective for the existing PR #226 Surya raw-fullframe worker. A valid benchmark PNG reached the worker during the Draft PR #230 Cloud Run CPU experiment but was rejected before OCR because the worker read EXIF metadata and then called Pillow verify() on the same image object; current Pillow requires verify() directly after Image.open() for PNG. PR #231 verifies the bounded encoded bytes on a fresh open, then reopens the same bytes for EXIF/oriented-dimension inspection, and adds a synthetic PNG regression test. It changes no provider, model, network destination, privacy boundary, production upload, PII masking, Gemini/legal-analysis path, storage, or active architecture. The canonical next_step_id remains surya-raw-fullframe-gpu-execution-v1; after this corrective is merged, Draft PR #230 must rebuild/redeploy its image before any Cloud Run cold/warm OCR result is treated as evidence.
